constraints: itemPos must be expressed relative to the current expanded/collapsed state of the list and its sublists; valid range is 1 to Count list items, otherwise the command returns empty values (0, "") in the out parameters.

overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether a leading '*' is passed (selecting whether 'list' is an object name string vs. a list reference number). That's one semantic overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator, not two overloads. Also corrected direction: itemRef, itemText, sublist, and expanded are all filled in by the command (docs mark them '←'), not passed in.

params.description: If present, 'list' below is an object name (string); if omitted, 'list' is a hierarchical list reference number.

params.name: list
params.description: Name of list type object (if '*' passed), or list reference number (if '*' omitted).

sentinelValues.meaning: the current item in the list
the item has no attached sublist

params.name: expanded
params.description: Only meaningful if the item has a sublist: TRUE if the sublist is currently expanded, FALSE if collapsed.
